1579 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1579 is not).  
Start date: 1579-03-02.  
Subtract 32 weeks = 224 days, plus 5 days = 229 days.  
March 2 minus 229 days:  
March 2 → back into February: 2 days into March, so Feb 28 (non-leap) is 2 days earlier → Feb 28 is day 59 of year.  
229 days earlier: day 59 - 229 = -170 days from start of year.  
Add 365 days of previous year 1578 (leap? 1578 not divisible by 4, so 365 days): -170 + 365 = day 195 of 1578.  
Day 195 in 1578: July 14 (31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days to June 30, plus 14 days = July 14).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1578-07-14
